commands.name: startup
commands.description: Collect a startup trace for a .NET MAUI app

options.name: --project
options.description: Path to the target .csproj or a directory containing it (default: current directory)

options.name: --framework
options.description: Target framework to profile (for example net10.0-android)

options.name: --device
options.description: Device or simulator identifier to target (defaults to the only running compatible device)

options.name: --output
options.description: Output trace path (default: <project>_<timestamp>.nettrace in the current directory). Speedscope and MIBC also emit sibling derived files while keeping the raw .nettrace.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format to generate: nettrace (default), speedscope, or mibc. [default: nettrace]

options.name: --configuration
options.description: Build configuration to use. Defaults to Release. [default: Release]

options.name: --platform
options.description: Target platform to profile. When omitted, the platform is inferred from the selected target framework. [default: all]

options.name: --duration
options.description: Optional trace duration in hh:mm:ss format. If omitted, press Enter to stop the trace.

options.name: --trace-profile
options.description: Optional dotnet-trace profile(s), for example dotnet-sampled-thread-time or gc-verbose

options.name: --no-build
options.description: Skip the build step and just deploy/run with the existing outputs [default: False]

options.name: --diagnostic-port
options.description: Preferred TCP port for the diagnostic connection. If it's busy, the next free port is used. [default: 9000]

options.name: --stopping-event-provider-name
options.description: Optional event provider name for an event-based stop condition. When omitted, the startup trace waits for --duration or a manual Enter stop.

options.name: --stopping-event-event-name
options.description: Optional event name to combine with --stopping-event-provider-name.

options.name: --stopping-event-payload-filter
options.description: Optional payload filter (key:value,key:value) to combine with the stopping event options

options.name: --scope
options.description: Install scope: project, user, or both [default: project]

options.name: --target
options.description: Skill target preset: auto, claude (.claude/skills), github (.github/skills), agent (.agent/skills), or agents (.agents/skills) [default: auto]

options.name: --path
options.description: Custom skill directory relative to the selected scope root, for example .agent/skills

options.name: --force
options.description: Force replacement, including skills installed by a newer CLI [default: False]

options.name: --allow-downgrade
options.description: Allow replacing skills installed by a newer CLI [default: False]

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Ask before deleting legacy skills or overwriting dirty current skills [default: False]
